final: WITH player_groups AS (SELECT player_id, AVG(1.0 * points_won / points_max) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM player_award_vote GROUP BY player_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_record_count FROM player_groups) SELECT AVG(p.avg_ratio), AVG(p.record_count), AVG(p.record_count - o.avg_record_count) FROM player_groups AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_record_count IS NOT NULL AND p.record_count > o.avg_record_count
